verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own site says its Bionic agent can create and edit documents and that every change is saved automatically, which covers the core story. A hands-on community user reports Bionic "works great" as an agentic harness, though that report does not specifically confirm the document-editing or autosave behavior. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the document workspace (editing UI, file formats, versioning/history of autosaved changes), independent hands-on corroboration of document drafting and autosave specifically.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically

citations.quote: Work with Bionic to create and edit documents. Every change is automatically saved, so you can work with your agent freely.
I really love LM Studio so I gave Bionic a shot immediately. First impression: it works great
